firm_data.firm_description: Togut, Segal & Segal LLP is a highly specialized “boutique” law firm with a national reputation for excellence in bankruptcy, corporate reorganization, fiduciary representation, and creditors’ rights. Established in 1980, the Togut Firm has extensive expertise in representing debtors, official committees, secured and unsecured creditors, and bankruptcy trustees in a variety of contexts, including in- and out-of-court restructurings.
notable_facts: They have served as counsel in hundreds of bankruptcy cases, including LATAM Airlines, McClatchy Newspapers, Enron, Chrysler, GM, City of Detroit, Pacific Drilling, Toisa, Westinghouse, Aéropostale, SunEdison, Trident Healthcare, Frontier Airlines, Tronox, Dewey & LeBoeuf LLP, St. Vincent’s Hospital, Rockefeller Center Properties, Ames Department Stores, Contimortgage and many more.
